data.title: 红莲 · 竹林私汤的月下舒展
data.description: 幽静竹林掩映的私人露天温泉，夜空悬挂着一轮皎洁明月。红莲倚靠在光滑的池边青石上，清澈泉水没至胸际。雪白的长发浸润在温热泉水中如丝散开，水珠滑过她泛红的光洁脊背，她侧眸回望，冷冽的剑气在升腾的热气中化作脉脉深情。
data.location: secluded outdoor natural hot spring surrounded by bamboo and night mist
data.action: leaning back against smooth stones in outdoor hot spring, long wet white hair trailing in water, bare back and shoulders glistening with water drops, moonlit steam, looking over shoulder
data.lighting: cool blue moonlight blending with warm submerged stone lights and mist
data.mood: poetic nocturnal beauty, alluring tranquil strength
data.promptProse: Leaning against mossy rocks in a moonlit outdoor hot spring surrounded by bamboo, Scarlet turns with glistening wet white hair. Steam swirls around her bare shoulders in the cool night air.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet resting in an outdoor hot spring under the moonlight, looking back gracefully.
